_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A historical keyword_search call renders its successful result (the stored call has an array of terms). "The card" is the completed tool card, .tool[data-testid="tool-call-completed"], whose ".tool-command" contains "find authentication handlers"; all checks below are inside the card unless said otherwise. Perform the steps in order. 1. Call "tool registry"; it must return "keyword_search is not registered". 2. Navigate to /c/historical-search. 3. The card should be visible. 4. Its ".tool-emoji" text should be exactly "🔍". 5. Its ".tool-header" text must contain neither "✓" nor "✗" (one assert_text_not_contains on that header for each). 6. Its ".tool-details" must be hidden (or absent). 7. Click the card's ".tool-header", then move the mouse away to the viewport's top-left corner (a hover step with no selector at x 0, y 0). 8. There must be no message action bar anywhere on the page: "[data-action-bar]" count 0. 9. The card's ".tool-code" elements must be exactly three, with whitespace-normalised texts, in order, exactly "find authentication handlers", "auth, handler" and "src/auth.ts:42: handleLogin". 10. The card's ".tool-time" text should be exactly "1.0s". 11. The card's last ".tool-label" should contain "Results:". 12. The card's ".tool-code.error" count should be exactly 0. 13. Click the card's collapse button, button[aria-label="Collapse"] inside the card. 14. The card's ".tool-details" should become hidden (or absent).

steps.expression: (() => { const labels = document.querySelectorAll('.tool[data-testid="tool-call-completed"] .tool-label'); const last = labels[labels.length - 1]; if (!last) return 'no labels'; const t = last.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return t.includes("Results:") ? 'ok' : t; })()
